objective: Zero-cost deterministic rescore of frozen artifacts: quantify per-book scope selection between the layered primary channel and the full-page champion, and re-measure dual-channel consensus at character grain inside the existing column pairing to recover coverage at the improved precision.
hypothesis: Choosing scope per book from development evidence lands macro CER near the 0.355552 per-page oracle, identifying which AncientDoc volumes annotate commentary into gold; and character-grain agreement within paired columns restores at least 0.80 recall of healthy-page gold while holding at least 0.96 precision.

method.scope_selection: Group the 28 development pages by volume title (second stratum). For each of the 14 books compare mean page CER of the layered primary channel (with the recorded one-layer empty-primary repair) against the full-page champion transcription; select the lower-mean scope for the whole book, ties to full-page. Scope flags are development-derived suite metadata: qualification-reserve books are disjoint, so any future use requires per-book derivation there or versioned gold correction.
method.consensus_grain: For every paired line-column operation in the frozen pairing, take equal blocks of the character-level minimum-edit alignment between the no-space line and no-space column texts as agreed characters; whole-column agreement is the existing special case. Score agreed text against no-space gold by the same equal-block method. Lines without a paired column contribute nothing.

gates.scope_macro: per-book scope selection macro CER at or below 0.40
gates.consensus_recovery: character-grain consensus reaches at least 0.80 recall of healthy-page gold at precision at least 0.96
gates.immutability: every consumed artifact hash matches this record; no prior artifact is modified

non_goals: No model calls of any kind.
Do not modify prior run artifacts or gold.
Do not promote or propose any candidate from this evidence.
next_permitted_action: Run the deterministic rescore, write the report and result record, and stop.
